name: Dot Dash Connect
author: Addicting Games
description: Dot Dash Connect is a free mobile puzzle game. In Dot Dash Connect it is your job to draw a dot-dash, dot-dash and don't crash. Don't crash. There will be balls that need to get from point A to point B and you are in charge of drawing a ramp, a line, or a series of ramps and lines in order to connect everything. Remember after you're finished drawing and you hit play the laws of gravity will come into effect and things drop, fall, push and pull! It is an interesting challenge and a very unique puzzle where time, space, physics and your ability to draw will all intersect to become one awesome game. See how far you can get, how fast you can get there, and how many tries it takes in order to win, then try to beat that score. You can do it. It won't be easy, but puzzle games aren't fun because they are easy they are fun because they are challenging. So, have fun by challenging your creative side and taking on this super fun puzzle.
